name: RealBench
description: RealBench is an automated evaluation benchmark for photorealistic text-to-image generation. It employs Detector-Scoring and Arena-Scoring to enable human-free photorealism assessment, providing results that align closely with real user experience.
reputation: A recent benchmark for photorealistic text-to-image evaluation that is gaining attention for automated, human-free assessment, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Focuses on photorealism assessment using automated detector-based rewards; enables human-free evaluation.
